fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-11-13 (afternoon, 14:20): A water pump motor valued at around Rs. 25,000 was found missing from a premises near Vetri Colony Industrial Area. Buvaneswari Kannan reported the matter orally at Erode North PS; the contact number given was 9000000331. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. The complainant alleged that Chandran Subramani may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000064. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, afternoon, CCTV, suspect, mobile number, industrial area, call detail
